# ALTAIR academic project — full reference

This supplementary file mirrors the public project's evidence policy. This website is an independent academic project, not Sarkar's official website, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the brand. No transactions occur here. No student author name or qualifications have been supplied. No original publication date is asserted.

## Supplied concept specifications, not verified retail facts
ALTAIR: 100 ML parfum; ₹1,199 INR. Floral, fruity, woody, night profile. Top notes cherry and mulberry; heart notes night jasmine and datura; base note wood. Tagline: "For nights that smell like rain and feel like confidence."
The imagery and scent narrative are creative project material, not proof of official ALTAIR packaging or a report of personal testing.
The supplied 25% concentration, approximately 6–7-hour longevity on clothing, cruelty-free and Made in India positioning have not been established through ALTAIR-specific evidence. An official ALTAIR listing and the ALTAIR10 coupon have not been verified. No transactional Offer, Product rating, invented identifier, certification or review dataset is asserted.

## Official brand context
Sarkar (House of Sarkar) is a fragrance brand with its official website at https://www.sarkar.store.
Brand story: https://www.sarkar.store/pages/know-sarkar
Collection: https://www.sarkar.store/collections/shop-all
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofsarkar/?hl=en
Official brand support: support@sarkar.store — not support for this academic project.
Sarkar identifies Bhuvan Bam and Neel Gogia among its co-founders. Neel Gogia is a co-founder of IPLIX Media. They are not described here as perfumers or fragrance reviewers. External launch coverage also names Rohit Raj and Jag Chima.
Editorial reference: https://india.entrepreneur.com/business-news/bhuvan-bam-launches-premium-fragrance-brand
The official Know Sarkar page makes a brand-level 25% oil concentration claim. This does not independently verify ALTAIR.

Full thread access was blocked. No detailed content description or verified purchase status is asserted. It is not an official brand profile or a rating dataset.

Accessible page metadata identified a Tarique Fragrance post about Sarkar perfumes. The video and detailed claims were not independently inspected. It is not treated as a verified customer review or official profile.

## General educational references
Perfume concentration and storage context: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perfume
IFRA standards: https://ifrafragrance.org/safe-use/understanding-the-standards
Parfum is a concentration category; it does not by itself establish exact concentration or guaranteed longevity. Performance varies with formulation, application and conditions. Follow product label instructions and warnings; keep perfume closed and away from heat and direct light. IFRA publishes ingredient-use standards, rather than certifying finished perfumes. No ALTAIR conformity document has been verified.
A brand statement establishes what the brand says; it is not independent testing. Third-party commentary is not automatically a verified customer review.
